Japan's real, PPP-adjusted GDP per capita rose roughly 18 to 20 times between 1950 and 2016, about a 1,800 to 1,900% increase. My earlier answer of about tenfold was too low. This is from recalled Maddison Project-style figures (roughly $1,900 in 1950 and mid-$30,000s in 2016, in 1990 international dollars), not a live data check.

CONFIDENCE: 60
